description: HARD evaluation set for the Bible RAG assistant. Stresses the system with precise-detail questions (numbers/ages), non-KJV paraphrasing, precision traps (common-wrong-answer questions), and near-miss off-topic questions that sound biblical but are not answerable from the text. Number keywords include both digit and KJV word forms because the LLM answers in digits while the source spells numbers out.
